name: prices-basic
notes: A worked validation suite (ADR-0015): run with `python -m dskit.onboarding validate --suite examples/onboarding/suite-basic.json --snapshot <vid>`. Each rule produces a FAILING COUNT over the target stream's normalized rows; the severity's threshold (error_if / warn_if, default '!= 0') gates on that count. Any tripped error rule -> gating 'block' (exit 3 — a result, not an error); tripped warn rules -> 'warn' (warn NEVER blocks); else 'pass'. Certification consumes the registered result, never the data.

rules.notes: An empty stream is a broken pull, not a quiet day. Raise min to your expected floor.
Nulls in the field downstream models train on. Loosen with error_if '> 10' to tolerate a known-dirty tail.
effective_date <= acquired_at, re-asserted as recorded evidence (acquire already refuses violations at save time).
A new symbol is worth a look, not a blocked publish — warn never blocks (the dbt threshold model).
